description: This file defines a PySide6 GUI dialog class 'ModifiersList' for selecting modifiers in the BORIS behavioral observation software. It manages UI elements, user interactions, and retrieval of selected modifiers.

classes.name: ModifiersList
classes.description: A dialog for selecting behavior modifiers, supporting single, multi, and numeric types, with event handling and modifier retrieval.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the dialog, sets up UI components, and populates modifier options based on provided data.

methods.name: eventFilter
methods.description: Handles key press events for dialog interaction, including navigation and selection.

methods.name: get_modifiers
methods.description: Returns the current state of selected modifiers.

methods.name: pbOK_clicked
methods.description: Validates numeric inputs and confirms selection when OK is clicked.
